Type: woven dining chair, set of two
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: wood frame in a warm stained finish, cane back panel, woven vegan leather strap seat
Colors: warm mid-brown wood, cream, light natural cane
Shape: armless, straight square back with inset cane panel, flat woven strap seat, four straight square legs, simple and compact
Feel: warm, crafted, relaxed
Goes with: walnut or oak tables, white or beige walls, rattan accents; Scandinavian, mid-century or coastal rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Erikson Vegan Leather Woven Dining Chair, Set of 2, 18"W, Beige
product.description: The retro feel of this dining room chair adds a hint of whimsy to your decor. The rattan backrest and woven vegan-leather seat contribute textural interest while also offering a comfortable place to sit, eat, and converse with friends and family. 18"W x 21.5"D x 35.75"H; seat height: 18.5"H; seat depth: 17"D; seat back height: 17.5"H; leg height: 15"H The solid wood frame and rattan backrest are strong and durable, while the seat is woven from strips of vegan leather. As stylish as it is functional, the woven seat of this chair is exceptionally comfortable. The woven rattan back finds a stylish echo in the woven strips of vegan leather that form the seat of this striking wood-framed chair. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Avoid moisture. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
